statement: An unbounded character class in front of an alternation or inside a repeated group can hang on unforeseen input; a scanner that spins on its input has stopped being a scanner. Cejel env-template filename matching used an ambiguous repeated dotted group. Replacing repetition with one optional group retains the language because the character class already accepts dots. The initially prescribed dot-excluding class changed classifications and was withdrawn after the equivalence gate found counterexamples. Preserve legitimate edge cases and prove bounded execution with an interruptible adversarial guard, rather than assuming a regex simplification is equivalent.
